name: E-RAY TECHNOLOGY CO LTD
summary: e-Ray Technology Co., Ltd. provides chemical material solutions for the semiconductor and advanced PCB manufacturing industry in Taiwan. The company engages in OLED material development focusing on electronic resins and semiconductor packaging materials. Its products include semiconductor packaging materials, CCL specialty chemicals, and organometallic catalysts. The company was formerly known as e-Ray Optoelectronics Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to e-Ray Technology Co., Ltd. in September 2025. e-Ray Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.
